bonuses.leadin: A man from this family with the agnomen Nasica claimed that “Carthage must be saved” so all Romans would fear a common enemy. For 10 points each:
parts: Carthage was destroyed by Aemilianus, a general from what family? Another member of this family got the agnomen Africanus for defeating Hannibal at the Battle of Zama.
Sallust explored the concept of fear of an enemy in a monograph about the war with Jugurtha, a ruler of this kingdom. Cavalry from this North African kingdom helped the Romans win the Battle of Zama.
Carthage had 80 of these animals during their loss at Zama. Hannibal earlier crossed the Alps with these tusked mammals.
answers: Scipiones [accept Publius Cornelius Scipio Nasica Corculum; accept Publius Cornelius Scipio Aemilianus Africanus or Scipio Africanus the Younger; accept Publius Cornelius Scipio Africanus; prompt on Cornelius or gens Cornelia by asking “what cognomen do the men share?”]
